  "evidence": "nslookup from the internal DNS view returns 10.10.9.9 with a zone serial modified 8 months ago, and the internal DNS configuration explicitly maps wiki.company.com to that outdated IP.",
  "next_command": "show ip dns server records (or equivalent DNS server zone record check for the internal zone)",
  "fix_steps": [
    "Access the internal DNS server or authoritative zone file for company.com.",
    "Update the A record for wiki.company.com to point to the correct internal server IP.",
    "Increment the zone serial number so secondary servers and clients recognize the update.",
    "Flush local DNS cache and re-test resolution from an internal client using nslookup."

parsed.root_cause: The internal DNS view contains an outdated A record pointing wiki.company.com to an old server IP (10.10.9.9) with an unincremented zone serial, whereas the external view points to the correct cloud-hosted IP.
parsed.evidence: nslookup from the internal DNS view returns 10.10.9.9 with a zone serial modified 8 months ago, and the internal DNS configuration explicitly maps wiki.company.com to that outdated IP.
parsed.next_command: show ip dns server records (or equivalent DNS server zone record check for the internal zone)
fix_steps: Access the internal DNS server or authoritative zone file for company.com.
Update the A record for wiki.company.com to point to the correct internal server IP.
Increment the zone serial number so secondary servers and clients recognize the update.
Flush local DNS cache and re-test resolution from an internal client using nslookup.
